config.affordance_template: an object associated with the action: {label}.

run.preprocess:
Compose(
    Resize(size=224, interpolation=bicubic, max_size=None, antialias=True)
    CenterCrop(size=(224, 224))
    <function _convert_image_to_rgb>
    ToTensor()
    Normalize(mean=(0.48145466, 0.4578275, 0.40821073), std=(0.26862954, 0.26130258, 0.27577711))
)
run.metric_scale: fractions in [0,1]; multiply by 100 for percent
run.ap_definition: sklearn non-interpolated AP; exclude labels with no positives, matching OCL
run.score_definition: L2-normalized image features @ L2-normalized text features.T; no softmax

coverage.selection_rule: Object counts in the full requested split; ties use official category ID
coverage.availability_check: file presence and QA exclusion hash; decode/crop failures raise during iteration
